text:
deploy-bot: rolling CONFIG-ONLY push 'driftshield-v2' kicking off in change window 20:00-22:00 UTC. plan: canary 3% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%. keys: tenant_rate_limits, request_timeout_ms, batch_window_ms, routing_weight, kv_cache_warmup_threads. tagging ops and oncall.
alex: dropping the config diff for quick review:
{
  "tenant_rate_limits": {"min_rps": 0.6, "max_rps": 45},
  "request_timeout_ms": 14000,
  "batch_window_ms": 10,
  "routing_weight": {"primary": 0.88, "fallback": 0.12},
  "kv_cache_warmup": true,
  "kv_cache_warmup_threads": 2
}
marta: quick question 100: why bump timeout to 14s? are we expecting more LLM retries?
jordan: brief: some model variants we've onboarded have longer 1st-token tails. 14s limits spurious client retries; perf sims show fewer downstream 429s.
sre-oncall: please set soft guardrails: if mem_usage_pct > 72% OR host swaps > 0 for 3m -> pause rollout and notify #incidents. Also set per-host override to kv_cache_warmup_threads=0 while investigating.
deploy-bot: acked. added auto-pause on mem and swap, and per-host override mechanism. canary step 1 -> 3% now.
ops: FYI reducing batch_window to 10ms compared to previous 12ms in tests reduced latency tail in our dev cluster. keep an eye on small-tenant floors.
alex: 3% steady for 4m. metrics: p95=170ms (baseline 168ms), err_rate=0.06%, mem=58%, kvcache_miss=0.6%. proceeding to 20%.
marta: tagging @ops 12 please ensure observability hooks capture kvcache_prefill and thread counts. want traces if prefill stalls.
jordan: will add tracepoints and start sampling at ramp start. also enabling lightweight request sampling for human eval.
deploy-bot: 20% in progress. small spike on p95 to 205ms during ramp, stabilized at 180ms after 2min. no errors above threshold.
sre-oncall: noticed one host (gpu-07) mem climbed to 75% — rolling pause on that shard. applying per-host override: kv_cache_warmup_threads=0 on gpu-07.
alex: acknowledged pause. hold further ramps until gpu-07 stabilizes. anyone remote to gpu-07?
jordan: pulling logs, prefill worker spawned 8 threads on that shard despite global=2 (race in agent). applying hotfix to agent to respect per-host override.
marta: good catch. ops, can you patch agent and restart that shard? minimize restarts overall.
ops: patch applied, restarted shard gracefully. gpu-07 mem back to 60% within 90s. no OOMs.
deploy-bot: override applied and recorded. canary resumes at 20% -> ramping to 60% in 2m. monitors: mem headroom OK, swap=0, p95=182ms.
alex: flag for release notes: add "host-level kv warmup overrides + agent fix to respect overrides". also note timeout change rationale.
marta: if 60% shows any kvcache thrash, fallback plan: set routing_weight.primary=0.85 and batch_window_ms=6, then revert warmup after 30m.
jordan: putting regression eval on a 10k-sample window and diffing embeddings for quality drift.
sre-oncall: auto-pause trigger fired briefly for gpu-12 (mem spike), but override prevented rollback. confirm behavior is acceptable?
alex: that's okay. prefer pause+override vs full rollback. document behavior in postmortem.
deploy-bot: ramp to 60% complete at 1759209200. health: p95=176ms, error_rate=0.09%, mem=61%.
marta: doing a quick spot-check on logs 14 nothing alarming. Jordan, can you collect a sample of warmup perf counters?
jordan: uploaded counters to https://internal.redwood/ops/kv-warmup/175920. i see slightly higher mutex contention during prefill but within expected range.
sre-oncall: all clear to go to 100% but keep aggressive alerting for next 30m. set incident paging thresholds.
alex: rolling to 100% now. deploy-bot: final rollout started.
deploy-bot: FINAL status at 1759209410: 100% rolled. no rollback. summary saved.
ops: creating release-note PR and tagging docs.
marta: nice. we'll run a short retro if any late effects show up. closing thread after PR lands
